hypothesis: A confidence target computed over equal-weight superpoints may alias masks with different point-level IoU when superpoint occupancies differ. Determine whether the ACTUAL unchanged W2 quality target has this mismatch before proposing any correction.
matched_control: Freeze identical superpoint predictions and object labels, vary only integer point masses, and compare native quality targets against exact expanded-point IoU. Include uniform masses, a nonuniform target-order reversal, empty masks, and a direct source audit of the real training target and evaluation path.
prediction_and_falsification: The premise is falsified for the current implementation if native targets already use the same point masses as point evaluation. No-op or uniform-mass agreement alone cannot establish it.
sampling: Source-level exact controls; no validation-based selection.
first_test: Locate and execute the actual native target helper on CPU.
limits: A diagnostic only: no model implementation, admission, Git commit or launch. Cannot infer population efficacy from synthetic controls.
